Chapter 1871: Plotting Change (I)

Dim watery light shimmered over the collapsed stone walls, where enormous serpentine bodies wound through faded murals. The Grand Daoist Master's shadow flickered faintly across the wreckage.

Suiguan's smile grew wider.

At the same time, the entire demon palace hidden within the reflection began to tremble. Surging light of Pristine Water streamed from every crack in the stone, climbing the fallen pillars like countless green snakes!

The green snakes climbed over one another. Wings sprouted from their backs, and they took flight with a rustling sound. The reflection across the entire stretch of sea trembled and rose, its colors overlapping, as though it might burst through the surface at any moment and drag the two cultivators inside.

More deadly still was the lingering music echoing through the reflection. Notes like flowing water and hollow chimes answered one another in sequence, moving any who heard them to tears.

Yet the two above the sea noticed nothing.

A flicker of doubt crossed Suiguan's eyes. He clasped his hands behind his back and fell silent. All the phenomena vanished in an instant, and watery light once more settled over the ruined walls.

Was I imagining it...?

Through [Spring's Echo], Suiguan resonated with these ruins and borrowed its mystics. Their effects could not simply be ignored by someone choosing not to react. Even if Li Ximing were a Grand Daoist Master, he would betray a reaction as long as he could see or hear them.

No reaction at all...

Am I being overly suspicious... or did he truly sense my gaze just now?

This was not a time when this place revealed itself to the outside world. Had Li Zhouwei come, Suiguan could have understood it, whether because of his fate or his extraordinary eyes. But Li Ximing... That was intriguing.

Even then, something would be amiss. Though the [Rain-Rousing Palace] now lies in ruins, I am concealed by [Chougui Hidden Form]. Sensing my gaze... should be far from easy.

His green-purple eyes shifted, and he remained silent for a long while.

He has now mastered his Fate Divine Ability as well. [Radiance Under Heaven]... Could it grant him such perception?

After a moment's thought, a smile edged with killing intent curled his lips.

"Du Qing has kept me hidden here for some time now... Chi Buzi hasn't appeared, but Li Ximing has turned up instead... Li Ximing... This is a probe from Moongaze Lake.

"According to that fellow Du's plan... anyone other than Chi Buzi can be ignored. But Li Ximing... may be in league with that man... Whether he saw me or not, now that he's appeared here, it would be safer to eliminate him. It will serve as a warning to them, too."

His green-purple eyes roamed freely as he strolled along. Though his movements appeared leisurely, he moved swiftly, following close behind the two above the water, his ghostlike gaze fixed on Li Ximing.

But as vast as Lesser Broadjade Mountain was, the two Daoist Masters were soon about to cross it. Suiguan stopped at the edge of the reflection, his expression turning cold, and hesitantly extended half a foot beyond it.

The moment half his foot crossed the boundary, watery light came crashing down. Countless colors surged, and the entire realm shook violently, as though mountains were collapsing and the earth itself was splitting apart. The demon palace began to crumble, as if issuing him a cold warning.

The Grand Daoist Master's expression grew colder as he watched the two streaks of divine ability disappear beyond the horizon. Silently withdrawing his foot, he regained his composure.

You bastard Du... you won't even let me kill him...

Suiguan watched the streaks of divine ability fade away through narrowed eyes for a long while before turning away. He stepped down through the air and returned to the throne, where he stood in silence. Only when the world outside had grown completely dark did he quietly seat himself and speak evenly.

"You think it would alert our quarry? What, Lord Pristine Water, is Chi Buzi himself more dangerous than the schemes of the Underworld's judiciary and the Origin Mansion?"

As his words faded into silence, dim Pristine Water radiance began winding through the ruins, illuminating countless treasures and golden vessels buried underground. Suiguan watched coldly before murmuring at last, "The True Dragon is imminent. This will be the dragons' only lapse in vigilance over the Pristine Water Position. Du Qing, oh Du Qing... You dismiss the schemes of all those powers, yet guard so closely against a mere lesser cultivator named Chi... Aren't you truly... losing sight of what matters?"

Yet the reflected realm remained utterly silent. Pristine Water radiance rose, bathing everything in green and white. His only answer was the cold sound of flowing water and the shifting clear and turbid currents lying dormant in the vault above.

————

The moon shone bright.

Pines swayed gently in the mountains as a cool breeze stirred. Li Ximing landed within another sect's grounds. Only when he saw its Purple Mansion formation seal shut did he feel he had escaped disaster. Secretly, he activated the Immortal Artifact.

That ghastly thing... hasn't followed us.

The moment he saw Suiguan rise beneath his feet, he had cut off the mystic. He knew nothing of what had happened afterward, but that hardly meant he felt nothing...

Heaven knew how many thoughts had raced through Li Ximing's mind during that brief journey across the mountain. Why was Suiguan here? Had that True Monarch arranged it? If he had stumbled upon their secret, who knew what would happen to him?!

The former palace of a dragon son... Another Golden Core power of Pristine Water... How many secrets are hidden here...

Perhaps even more chilling was Suiguan's reaction.

How can he be that perceptive...

Li Ximing had been investigating through the Immortal Mirror. It was the Immortal Artifact that had seen Suiguan, not Li Ximing himself! The movement of his eyes alone could not possibly have revealed anything conclusive.

He probably saw me passing through and deliberately tested me...

Even the Azure Pond Sect's own people grew uneasy at the sight of the fiendish Suiguan. Li Ximing now understood that feeling all too well. Still troubled, he cursed inwardly,

I am absolutely not passing Lesser Broadjade Mountain on the way back!

Forcing himself to calm down, he looked around and found himself in a Daoist temple. Few cultivators were in sight, and the mountain seemed quiet and sparsely inhabited. An old Daoist Master came out to welcome him.

The man wore plain robes with layers of golden patterns at the cuffs, shining especially brightly in the night. A faint halo of many colors hovered behind his head, illuminating his kindly features and distinguished bearing.

Yet he was exceedingly old, his face weathered by the years, and he seemed to be injured. He hurriedly greeted Li Ximing. "Daomian of [Mercury Circulation Terrace] greets your highness!"

With a glance, Li Ximing began to understand. The man before him was an early-stage Purple Mansion Realm cultivator of [Whole Pill], and should already possess two divine abilities.

This is [Mercury Circulation Terrace]?

Li Ximing was rather surprised. Glancing over the barren mountain beneath his feet, he suspected the man had even lost his sect's grounds to others and been forced to settle here.

He sighed. "You are too courteous, senior! A junior in my family also cultivates [Whole Pill], and is on the verge of a breakthrough. We may have many opportunities to exchange insights in the future!"

Liu Changdie had gone out of his way to connect him with Mercury Circulation Terrace for more than a few spirit materials and spirit items. Masters, lineage, and spirit items were particularly important to [Whole Pill]. He had already been laying the groundwork for Quewan.

Pleasantly surprised, Daomian nodded. "Wonderful... wonderful..."

[Mercury Circulation Terrace] was at the lowest point in its lineage's history. It had traded away untold generations of accumulated wealth, yet still barely clung to survival... How could he not be delighted after hearing Li Ximing's words? Even the weariness on his face seemed to ease.
